about: r262: an even white slab through FOG, amplitude 1, 20 of 40 units wide and 5 tall, tiling on Y only, scrolled up too (speedY 30) so it wraps on Y. y5 (the shaders round's s07): wavelength 5, FOG's y period 50 units, ten times the image: before r262 it cut at every tile edge on Y; the noise now runs on across them. y05: wavelength 0.5, a y period of 5, the image's height: no cut either way.
